name: @wxyc/auth-log-prune
description: Daily EC2-cron auth-log prune (BS#2363): delete station_signup_attempt rows older than the 30-day audit retention window via the already-exported pruneSignupAttempts (shared/authentication/src/station-passcode.ts). Never touches station_passcode. Split from jobs/station-signup-review because the failure consequences differ -- a failed prune just grows the table, a failed review is a silent queue and a security gap -- and those want separate alerting.
